name: GROKD deposit contract unauthenticated updatePool
summary: The GROKD LP-staking deposit contract (UUPS proxy 0x31d3231c, implementation 0xec61196d) exposes updatePool(uint256 pid, (startBlock, endBlock, rewardPerBlock)) without any caller check: it only requires pid < pool count and overwrites the pool's reward schedule. After staking 1 LP through the ordinary deposit() one transaction earlier, the attacker contract set pool 0's rewardPerBlock from 0.1875 to 969,437,458 GROKD and called reward() in the same transaction, collecting 1,346,001.9 GROKD, almost the contract's entire GROKD reward balance, which it sold for 157.67 BNB.
notes: upgradeToAndCall by the proxy admin emitted Upgraded(0xec61196d), the implementation executed by the exploit; it is the sixth and last pre-exploit Upgraded event, and the next one (37622860) is the post-exploit fix.

Exact victim depletion: GROKD balanceOf(deposit proxy) falls from 1346594.907093285618305585 to 592.991783799382637245 across source-1, equal to the reward() transfer of 1346001.91530948623566834 GROKD to the attack contract. GROKD has no DefiLlama quote and the attacker's own sales moved the GROKD/WBNB pair, so it is valued at realised proceeds: five sells (source-8..source-12, blocks 37622485..37622533) disposed of exactly that amount (4 x 300000 + 146001.91530948623566834 GROKD) and paid the attacker EOA 157.669066410511957157 BNB, valued at the DefiLlama WBNB quote 582.04 at the anchor (source-7). The GROKD transfer tax (3.5% of each sell, swapped by the token contract for its own recipients) is not in the attacker's proceeds, so the realised value is conservative. The attacker's 0.2 BNB LP purchase and 1 LP stake in 0x383dbb44 are attacker inputs and are not subtracted.
